places.name: Collegiate Church of Notre-Dame
places.ai_summary: The Collegiate Church of Notre-Dame is a stunning Gothic church in Dinant, known for its unique onion-shaped bell tower and beautiful stained glass windows. It is a symbol of the city and a must-visit landmark.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during religious services.

places.place_tip: Admire the stained glass windows during daylight hours.

places.name: Citadel of Dinant
places.ai_summary: The Citadel of Dinant is a historic fortress offering panoramic views of the Meuse River and the city. Visitors can explore its museum, learn about its military history, and enjoy the cable car ride.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during winter months.

places.place_tip: Take the cable car for a scenic ride to the top.

places.name: Saxophone Bridge
places.ai_summary: The Saxophone Bridge is a pedestrian bridge in Dinant, famous for its saxophone-shaped design, paying homage to the city's connection to the saxophone's inventor, Adolphe Sax.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight for photos.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning or late afternoon for the best light for photos.

places.name: Meuse River Cruise
places.ai_summary: The Meuse River Cruise offers a unique perspective of Dinant and its surroundings, allowing visitors to relax and enjoy the scenic beauty of the Meuse Valley.

opening_hours.notes: Cruises may not operate in winter; check schedule in advance.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning river valley views.
places.address: Quai des Comtes de Namur, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Charles de Gaulle Statue
places.ai_summary: The Charles de Gaulle Statue in Dinant commemorates the French leader's visit to the city in 1944. The statue is located in a small park and is a popular photo spot.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Citadel for a complete experience.
places.address: Place Charles de Gaulle, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Dinant Caves (La Merveilleuse)
places.ai_summary: The Dinant Caves, also known as La Merveilleuse, are famous for their impressive stalactites and stalagmites. The caves offer guided tours that showcase their natural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in January; check schedule for guided tour times.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the cave tour.
places.address: Rue de la Merveilleuse 1, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Bayard Rock
places.ai_summary: Bayard Rock is a large rock formation in the Meuse River, near Dinant. It is associated with local legends and offers a picturesque spot for photos.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight.

places.place_tip: Combine with a river cruise for a complete experience.

places.name: Dinant Brewery (Leffe Experience)
places.ai_summary: The Dinant Brewery, known for its Leffe beer, offers guided tours where visitors can learn about the brewing process and enjoy beer tastings.

opening_hours.notes: Last tour starts at 17:00; closed on December 25th.

places.place_tip: Try the different varieties of Leffe beer during the tasting.
places.address: Rue de la Brasserie 1, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Dinant Cable Car
places.ai_summary: The Dinant Cable Car takes visitors from the town up to the Citadel, offering stunning views of the Meuse River and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Ride the cable car both ways for a complete experience.
places.address: Rue de la Citadelle, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Dinant Old Town
places.ai_summary: Dinant Old Town is known for its picturesque streets, historic buildings, and vibrant atmosphere. It's a great place to explore on foot and soak in the local culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; wear comfortable shoes.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the local shops and cafes.

places.name: Adolphe Sax Museum
places.ai_summary: The Adolphe Sax Museum is dedicated to the life and work of Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone. The museum is located in his birthplace and showcases various saxophones and other artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Check for any special exhibitions or events.

places.name: Lesse Kayaking Tour
places.ai_summary: The Lesse Kayaking Tour is a popular activity in Dinant, allowing visitors to explore the beautiful Lesse River by kayak. The tour typically includes equipment rental and a guided trip.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially in summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes; you might get wet!
places.address: Rue de la Lesse, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

places.name: Grotte de Dinant
places.ai_summary: The Grotte de Dinant is a cave located near the city, known for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites. It offers guided tours that explore its underground chambers.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in January; check schedule for guided tour times.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the cave tour.
places.address: Rue de la Grotte, 5500 Dinant, Belgium

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; wear comfortable shoes.

places.place_tip: Don't forget your camera for the stunning views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the view.

places.place_tip: Try the local pastries at a nearby cafe.

places.place_tip: Consider a boat rental for a unique view of Dinant.

opening_hours.notes: Last tour starts at 17:00; closed on December 25th.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to taste the different Leffe beers.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in January; check website for seasonal hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the view of the Meuse River.
